scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @leaktrace/fingerprint && npm run build --workspace @leaktrace/shared
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @leaktrace/api" "npm run dev --workspace @leaktrace/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @leaktrace/fingerprint && npm run test --workspace @leaktrace/api
